dockerfile.description: Un-ignore test directories for the dockerfile manager only. `github>owine/renovate-config` -> default.json -> config:best-practices -> config:recommended -> :ignoreModulesAndTests sets a top-level ignorePaths that includes `**/tests/**`, which silently hid tests/e2e/visual.Dockerfile from its introduction in #171 until #323 found it pinned to a Playwright image two minors behind the npm client — the container failed at browser launch with `Executable doesn't exist`. An untracked file produces no PR, no error, and no Dependency Dashboard entry, so nothing ever reports it. This re-lists the inherited paths minus the three test-directory globs. It is manager-scoped on purpose: a top-level ignorePaths would replace the preset's list for EVERY manager, so npm and github-actions would start scanning fixture manifests under tests/. Kept local rather than pushed to the shared preset — un-ignoring test dirs fleet-wide off one data point is too broad.

regex.description: Same un-ignore as the `dockerfile` block above, applied to the custom regex manager. NOT redundant with it: managers are separate config namespaces, so un-ignoring test dirs for `dockerfile` does nothing for this one. The Alpine apk manager below matches `/Dockerfile$/`, which also matches tests/e2e/visual.Dockerfile, yet it inherits the preset's `**/tests/**` ignore independently. No live impact from that particular path today — the visual harness pins no apk packages — but adding one there would be silently untracked, reproducing the #171 -> #323 failure exactly. The key is `regex`, not `custom.regex`: that is the name Renovate's own schema registers this manager under for config scoping, and `ignorePaths` is rejected inline on a customManagers entry. **The two ignorePaths lists must stay in sync** — editing one does not propagate to the other. This block is now load-bearing rather than precautionary: the `annotated image pins` customManager below reads tests/integration/setup.ts, which `**/tests/**` would hide.

customManagers.description: `annotated image pins` — tracks container images pinned inside files no first-party manager can parse: a TypeScript constant (tests/integration/setup.ts) and a shell assignment (scripts/smoke-image.sh). Both were completely untracked before this: `getmeili/meilisearch` sat at v1.10 in the integration stack while docker-compose.yml and ci.yml had moved to v1.53, so every integration test validated against a search engine 43 minors behind production and nothing reported it. Same shape as the #171 -> #323 visual.Dockerfile miss, one layer further out. The contract is the `renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment on the line DIRECTLY above a single quoted `image:tag` literal — move either half and the pin goes silently untracked again, which is why both files carry a comment saying so. Reaching tests/integration/setup.ts also depends on the top-level `regex` ignorePaths block above: without it `:ignoreModulesAndTests`'s `**/tests/**` hides the file from this manager entirely.

packageRules.description: Alpine apk pins are extracted by Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager (>= 44.96.0) as datasource `apk`; the :alpine preset supplies the grouping, rangeStrategy and automerge posture but stays release-line agnostic, so this URL is the ONE place the Alpine release line is written. Bump `branch=v3.24` when the base image crosses a release line (3.24 -> 3.25). `components=main,community` merges both indexes in a single lookup (registryStrategy 'merge'), so community packages need no separate registryUrls override.
GitGuardian (action + ggshield CLI) must stay version-consistent

Adds the visual-harness base image to the `playwright` group. THE NPM SIDE IS NOT LISTED HERE ON PURPOSE — do not re-add @playwright/test: `github>owine/renovate-config:node` already groups playwright, playwright-core, @playwright/test and @axe-core/playwright under this exact group name (owine/renovate-config#92), and identical group names merge rather than conflict. That preset rule is `matchDatasources: [npm]`-scoped, so it structurally cannot reach a docker image; pulling mcr.microsoft.com/playwright in is the entire remaining job of this rule. The coupling it encodes is real but repo-local: tests/e2e/visual.Dockerfile pins `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:vX.Y.Z-noble` and the container fails at browser launch with `Executable doesn't exist` if the image and the npm client bump separately (#324, #325). Load-bearing detail: `github>owine/renovate-config:docker` -> `dockerfile bases` is matchManagers:[dockerfile] with an ALL-NEGATIVE package list, so it matches this image too — this rule wins only because a consumer's own packageRules are appended after everything from `extends` and the last matching rule sets groupName. Move it into a preset, or otherwise lose that ordering, and the image silently drifts into `dockerfile bases` while the npm client stays here. Note @axe-core/playwright now rides this group via the preset; the earlier local rule deliberately excluded it, and #92 reversed that call upstream because it peers on playwright-core.

Move every Meilisearch pin in one PR. The engine is pinned in three places under three different managers — docker-compose.yml (docker-compose), .github/workflows/ci.yml service containers (github-actions), and tests/integration/setup.ts (the `annotated image pins` customManager above) — and nothing upstream groups across managers, so left alone they bump in separate PRs and drift. That drift is not hypothetical: the integration stack sat on v1.10 against a v1.53 production for months. Identical reasoning to the `playwright` group directly above, where an image and its client bumping separately produced #324/#325. This rule is deliberately NOT update-type-scoped: a Meili major is exactly the case where all three must move together.

Same lockstep as the `meilisearch` group above, for Postgres. Pinned in four places across three managers: docker-compose.yml, ci.yml service containers, tests/integration/setup.ts and scripts/smoke-image.sh. It must be pgvector/pgvector rather than plain postgres — the squashed migration runs CREATE EXTENSION vector and `migrate deploy` fails without it — so a bump landing in only some of the four means the smoke test or the integration suite runs a different major than production.

NEVER pin a digest onto an image tracked by the `annotated image pins` customManager above. Its matchStrings capture `currentValue` only, so a TypeScript constant (`'getmeili/meilisearch:v1.53'`) and a shell assignment have nowhere to put a sha256: auto-replace rewrites the value, asserts the result contains newDigest, fails that assert, and hard-errors the WHOLE branch. Both the `meilisearch` and `postgres` groups above sat under Errored on the Dependency Dashboard for exactly this reason, even though their docker-compose.yml and ci.yml halves would have applied fine -- a grouped branch fails as a unit. Confirmed in the Mend log for run 0843b6d5: `manager=regex packageFile=tests/integration/setup.ts msg="Digest is not updated"` immediately followed by `Error updating branch: update failure`, on both branches. IDENTICAL SHAPE to the `uses-with` carve-out in github>owine/renovate-config default.json -- same failed assert, different manager -- so read that rule's description for the full mechanism. NO DIGEST COVERAGE IS LOST: ci.yml service containers stay digest-pinned (github-actions manager, pinDigests true), and docker-compose.yml is digest-free BY DESIGN per the preset's docker-compose rule ("keeps compose files readable for humans editing them by hand"). This customManager exists to stop VERSION drift -- the integration stack sat on v1.10 against a v1.53 production -- not to provide immutability. Scoped to the manager + docker datasource rather than to the two package names so a third annotated image pin added later cannot reintroduce the failure. If a second repo adopts annotated image pins, promote this to the shared preset rather than copying it.
